title: DataLife Read Block Trace
description: Block-range trace for read operations, produced by DataLife flow-monitor. Filename pattern: <file>.<pid>-<host>.r_blk_trace.json

io_blk_range.description: Flat array of block range pairs [start, end, start, end, ...]. Each pair describes a contiguous range of blocks accessed.

task_name.description: Optional task name for workflow correlation.
